import pandas as pd
import inflect
import re
import string
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

p = inflect.engine()

# Load and preprocess training data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
train_df["before"] = train_df["before"].astype(str)

# Create class-based lookups
class_lookup = train_df.groupby("before")["class"].agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0]).to_dict()
class_based_lookup = (
    train_df.groupby(["before", "class"])["after"].agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0]).to_dict()
)
full_lookup = train_df.groupby("before")["after"].agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0]).to_dict()

# Validation split
train_split, val_split = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)


def regex_classifier(token):
    """Predict class using regex patterns for unseen tokens"""
    if token in string.punctuation:
        return "PUNCT"
    if re.match(r"^[\$£€]\d+([.,]\d+)?$", token):
        return "MONEY"
    if re.match(r"^\d+(st|nd|rd|th)$", token, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "ORDINAL"
    if re.match(r"^\d+/\d+$", token):
        return "FRACTION"
    if re.match(r"^\d+:\d+([ap]m)?$", token, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "TIME"
    if re.match(r"^\d+([-./]\d+){1,2}$", token) and not re.search(r"[a-zA-Z]", token):
        return "DATE"
    if re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+$", token):
        return "DECIMAL"
    if re.match(r"^\d+$", token):
        return "CARDINAL"
    if any(c.isalpha() for c in token) and not any(c.isdigit() for c in token):
        return "PLAIN"
    return "PLAIN"


def normalize_token(token):
    if not token:
        return token

    # Predict class using training data first
    predicted_class = class_lookup.get(token, regex_classifier(token))
    class_key = (token, predicted_class)

    # Try class-based lookup
    if class_key in class_based_lookup:
        return class_based_lookup[class_key]

    # Fallback to general lookup
    if token in full_lookup:
        return full_lookup[token]

    # Existing rule-based normalization
    try:
        # Handle ordinals
        ordinal_match = re.match(r"^(\d+)(st|nd|rd|th)$", token, re.IGNORECASE)
        if ordinal_match:
            num = int(ordinal_match.group(1))
            return p.number_to_words(num, ordinal=True).replace("-", " ")

        # Handle fractions
        if "/" in token and re.match(r"^\d+/\d+$", token):
            num, den = token.split("/")
            return f"{p.number_to_words(num)} {p.number_to_words(den, ordinal=True)}"

        # Handle currency
        curr_match = re.match(r"^([\$£€])(\d+\.?\d*)$", token)
        if curr_match:
            symbol, amount = curr_match.groups()
            currency = {"$": "dollar", "£": "pound", "€": "euro"}[symbol]
            if "." in amount:
                dollars, cents = amount.split(".")
                return f"{p.number_to_words(dollars)} {currency}s and {p.number_to_words(cents)} cents"
            return f"{p.number_to_words(amount)} {currency}s"

        # Handle measurements
        if re.match(r"\d+[a-zA-Z]+", token):
            parts = re.findall(r"(\d+)([a-zA-Z]+)", token)
            normalized = []
            for val, unit in parts:
                unit_map = {
                    "ft": "feet",
                    "in": "inches",
                    "lb": "pounds",
                    "kg": "kilograms",
                    "cm": "centimeters",
                }
                normalized.append(
                    f"{p.number_to_words(val)} {unit_map.get(unit.lower(), unit)}"
                )
            return " ".join(normalized)

        # Handle plain numbers
        clean_num = re.sub(r"[^\d.-]", "", token)
        if re.match(r"^-?\d+\.?\d*$", clean_num):
            return p.number_to_words(clean_num).replace("-", " ").replace(",", "")

    except Exception:
        pass

    return token


# Validate

from pathlib import Path

# Train class predictor
X = train_df["before"]
y = train_df["class"]
classifier = make_pipeline(
    TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2), analyzer="char", max_features=5000),
    RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, max_depth=15, n_jobs=-1),
)
classifier.fit(X, y)


# Enhanced class-specific normalizers
class Normalizers:
    @staticmethod
    def plain(before, after):
        return after

    @staticmethod
    def punct(before, after):
        return after

    @staticmethod
    def date(text):
        if re.match(r"^\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]?\d{0,4}$", text):
            parts = re.split(r"[/-]", text)
            return " ".join(num2words(int(p)) for p in parts)
        return text

    @staticmethod
    def measure(text):
        unit_map = {
            "lb": "pounds",
            "lbs": "pounds",
            "kg": "kilograms",
            "km": "kilometers",
            "°c": "degrees celsius",
            "mph": "miles per hour",
            "$": "dollars",
            "€": "euros",
        }
        match = re.match(r"^([\d,\.]+)(\D+)$", text)
        if match:
            num, unit = match.groups()
            num = num.replace(",", "")
            unit = unit_map.get(unit.lower(), unit)
            try:
                return f"{num2words(float(num))} {unit}"
            except:
                pass
        return text

    @staticmethod
    def cardinal(text):
        try:
            return num2words(float(text.replace(",", "")))
        except:
            return text

    original = text.strip()

    # Apply class-specific normalization
    if cls == "DATE":
        return Normalizers.date(text)
    if cls in ["MEASURE", "DIGIT"]:
        return Normalizers.measure(text)
    if cls == "CARDINAL":
        return Normalizers.cardinal(text)
    if cls in ["PLAIN", "PUNCT"]:
        return original

    return original

def regex_classifier(token):
    token = token.strip()
    if not token:
        return "PLAIN"
    if token in string.punctuation:
        return "PUNCT"
    if re.match(r"^[\$£€]\d+([.,]\d+)?[bmk]?$", token, re.I):
        return "MONEY"
    if re.match(r"^\d+(st|nd|rd|th)$", token, re.I):
        return "ORDINAL"
    if re.match(r"^\d+/\d+$", token):
        return "FRACTION"
    if re.match(r"^\d+:\d+([ap]m)?$", re.sub(r"\s", "", token), re.I):
        return "TIME"
    if re.match(r"^\d+([-./]\d+){1,2}$", token) and not re.search(r"[a-zA-Z]", token):

    if re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+$", token):

    return "PLAIN"

            return p.number_to_words(clean_num).replace("-", " ").replace(",", "")

def get_text_features(X):

        features[i, 0] = len(text)
        features[i, 1] = int(bool(re.search(r"\d", text)))
        features[i, 2] = int("/" in text)
        features[i, 3] = int("$" in text or "€" in text)
    return features

class Normalizers:
    @staticmethod
    def date(text):
        text = str(text)
        # Expanded date patterns
        patterns = [
            (r"^\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2}([-/]\d{2,4})?$", "/-"),  # 12-25-2022
            (
                r"^(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)\s*\d{1,2}(st|nd|rd|th)?,?\s*\d{4}$",
                "month",
            ),  # Jan 5th, 2020
            (
                r"^\d{1,2}(st|nd|rd|th)\s+(of\s+)?(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)",
                "ordinal",
            ),  # 5th of July
        ]

        for pattern, ptype in patterns:
            if re.match(pattern, text, re.I):
                parts = re.split(r"[\s/-]+", text)
                return " ".join(
                    num2words(int(p), ordinal=True) if "th" in p else num2words(int(p))
                    for p in parts
                    if p.strip()
                )
        return text

    @staticmethod
    def measure(text):
        text = str(text).lower()
        # Expanded unit mapping
        unit_map = {
            **{u: f"{u}meters" for u in ["cm", "mm", "km", "m"]},
            **{u: f"{u}grams" for u in ["kg", "g", "mg"]},
            "ft": "feet",
            "'": "feet",
            "in": "inches",
            '"': "inches",
            "lb": "pounds",
            "lbs": "pounds",
            "mph": "miles per hour",
            "$": "dollars",
            "€": "euros",
            "%": "percent",
            "sq": "square",
        }

        match = re.match(r"^([\d,\.]+)(\D*)$", text)
        if match:
            num_part, unit_part = match.groups()
            num = num_part.replace(",", "")
            unit = "".join(unit_map.get(c, c) for c in unit_part)
            try:
                if "." in num:
                    return f"{num2words(float(num))} {unit}"
                return f"{num2words(int(num))} {unit}"
            except:
                pass
        return text

    @staticmethod
    def cardinal(text):
        text = str(text).replace(",", "").replace("+", "")
        # Handle ranges like 5-10
        if "-" in text:
            parts = text.split("-")
            try:
                return f"{num2words(parts[0])} to {num2words(parts[1])}"
            except:
                pass
        try:
            return num2words(float(text))
        except:
            return text

    )

        groups = currency_match.groups()

                    "lb": "pounds",
                    "kg": "kilograms",
                    "km": "kilometers",
                }
                result.append(unit_map.get(part.strip(), part))
        return " ".join(result)

    @staticmethod
    def cardinal(text):
        text = text.replace(",", "")
        if "/" in text:
            parts = text.split("/")
            return f"{num2words(parts[0])} over {num2words(parts[1])}"
        if "." in text:
            integer, decimal = text.split(".")
            return (
                f"{num2words(integer)} point {' '.join(num2words(d) for d in decimal)}"

def regex_classifier(token):
    token = token.strip().lower()
    if not token:
        return "PLAIN"
    if token in string.punctuation:
        return "PUNCT"
    if re.match(r"^[\$£€]?\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*(\.\d+)?[bmk]?[\$£€]?$", token):
        return "MONEY"
    if re.match(r"^\d+(st|nd|rd|th)$", token, re.I):
        return "ORDINAL"
    if re.match(r"^(\d+\s+)?\d+\/\d+$", token):
        return "FRACTION"
    if re.match(r"^\d{1,2}:\d{2}(:\d{2})?([ap]m)?$", token):
        return "TIME"
    if re.match(r"^\d{1,4}([-./]\d{1,4}){1,2}$", token) and not re.search(
        r"[a-z]", token
    ):
        return "DATE"
    if re.match(r"^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*\.\d+$", token):
        return "DECIMAL"
    if re.match(r"^-?\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*$", token):
        return "CARDINAL"
    return "PLAIN"

    if class_key in class_based_lookup:

    if original in full_lookup:

    try:
        measure_match = re.match(r"^([\d,.]+)([a-z°]+)$", original, re.I)

            num_part, unit_part = measure_match.groups()

                    unit = p.plural(unit)
            else:

                    unit += "s"

            if "." in clean_num:

                int_word = (
                    p.number_to_words(integer_part) if integer_part != "0" else ""
                )
                dec_word = " ".join(p.number_to_words(d) for d in decimal_part)
                num_word = (
                    f"{int_word} point {dec_word}"
                    if int_word
                    else f"zero point {dec_word}"
                )
            else:
                num_word = p.number_to_words(clean_num)

            return f"{num_word} {unit}".strip()

        curr_match = re.match(
            r"^([\$£€]?)(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)(?:\.(\d+))?([bmk]?)([\$£€]?)$",
            original,
            re.I,
        )
        if curr_match and (curr_match.group(1) or curr_match.group(5)):
            symbol = curr_match.group(1) or curr_match.group(5)
            int_part = curr_match.group(2).replace(",", "")
            dec_part = curr_match.group(3) or ""
            abbrev = curr_match.group(4).lower()

            amount = float(f"{int_part}.{dec_part}") if dec_part else int(int_part)
            abbrev_map = {"k": "thousand", "m": "million", "b": "billion"}
            amount_str = (
                f"{p.number_to_words(amount)} {abbrev_map[abbrev]}"
                if abbrev in abbrev_map
                else p.number_to_words(amount)
            )
            currency = {"$": "dollar", "£": "pound", "€": "euro"}.get(symbol, "dollar")
            plural = "s" if amount != 1 else ""
            return f"{amount_str} {currency}{plural}"

        if predicted_class == "FRACTION":
            if " " in original:
                integer_part, fraction = original.split(" ", 1)
                numerator, denominator = fraction.split("/")
                return f"{p.number_to_words(integer_part)} and {p.number_to_words(numerator)} {p.ordinal(denominator)}"
            else:
                numerator, denominator = original.split("/")
                return f"{p.number_to_words(numerator)} {p.ordinal(denominator)}"

        ordinal_match = re.match(r"^(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)(st|nd|rd|th)$", original, re.I)
        if ordinal_match:
            num = ordinal_match.group(1).replace(",", "")
            return p.ordinal(num).replace("-", " ")

    except Exception as e:

    return original

            abbrev = curr_match.group(4).lower()
